channel.title: Practical Prophets
channel.description: Practical Prophets brings the Jewish Nevi'im to life as immersive narrative nonfiction grounded in the Hebrew Tanakh. Each episode stays within a single biblical book, with a separate narrator adding Jewish commentary, Hebrew language insights, and context. This working edition uses two AI voices; Hebrew pronunciation and source review continue.

item.title: The River and the Promise
item.description: Joshua 1–5. After Moses dies, Joshua leads Israel to the Jordan. Rahab protects the scouts, Israel crosses the river, and the people celebrate Passover as the manna ends. Based on the Masoretic Hebrew Bible, with Jewish commentary in a distinct narrator voice. Content note: biblical warfare and violence.
item.itunes:author: Practical Prophets

item.title: Jericho and the Conquest
item.description: Joshua 6–13. Previously on Joshua, followed by the fall of Jericho, the defeat and recovery at Ai, the Gibeonites' treaty, the southern and northern campaigns, and the land still awaiting possession. Based on the Hebrew Tanakh with Jewish context and commentary. Content note: biblical warfare and violence.
item.itunes:author: Practical Prophets

item.title: The Land and the Covenant
item.description: Joshua 14–24. Previously on Joshua, then Caleb claims Hebron, the tribes inherit land, an altar almost provokes civil war, and Joshua renews Israel's covenant at Shechem. Based on the Hebrew Tanakh with Jewish context and commentary. Content note: biblical warfare and violence.
item.itunes:author: Practical Prophets

item.title: The Judges Who Rose and Fell
item.description: Judges (Shoftim) chapters 1–11. After Joshua dies, Israel's leaders struggle with unfinished conquest. Othniel, Ehud, Deborah, Gideon and Jephthah become deliverers, and their victories lead to difficult consequences. Literary retelling of the Hebrew Tanakh with Jewish commentary in a second voice. Working edition with AI narration; source and pronunciation review ongoing. Biblical warfare and violence.
item.itunes:author: Practical Prophets

item.title: Samson and a Nation Unraveling
item.description: Judges (Shoftim) chapters 12–21. A Previously on recap leads into Ephraim's civil conflict, Samson's birth and death, the Danite migration, the crime at Gibeah and the near extinction of Benjamin. Literary retelling of the Hebrew Tanakh with Jewish commentary in a second voice. Working edition with AI narration; source and pronunciation review ongoing. Content warning: sexual assault, abduction and extensive violence.
